title: cross-functional-launch-async-tracker-q2
summary: Lightweight, ad-hoc tracker used to coordinate launch dependencies across Eng/Product/SRE/Growth/security for a scoped Q2 experiment. Purpose: unblock fast decisions and surface blockers for weekly async sync.
content:
Cross-functional Launch Async Tracker — Q2 2025 (working sheet)

Last sync: 2025-03-04 by Lena Ortiz (notes below)
Purpose: minimal single-pane-of-glass for owners to update status quickly; not a replacement for full JIRA boards.

Columns: Item | Team owner | Owner (person) | Status | Next action (this week) | ETA | Blocker notes | Est dev hours | Related tickets/links

1) Host API rate-limiting guardrails | eng-hosted-api | Marcus Nguyen | in_progress | prod smoke test + add rate-limit headers | 2025-03-07 | need test tokens from security (see blocker) | 4h | JIRA-5210, PR: github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/782

2) Dedicated capacity canary policy | eng-dedicated | Aisha Patel | blocked | finalize rollback policy doc | 2025-03-10 | awaiting legal OK on contract language for reserved burst | 6h | confluence:dedicated-canary, JIRA-5172

3) Private deployment quickstart update | product-private | Tomás Rivera | in_review | fold in customer feedback + update snippet | 2025-03-06 | none | 3h | github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/45

4) Console rollout: per-route observability flag | product-console | Lena Ortiz | in_progress | create dashboard widget mock + ask SRE for traces | 2025-03-09 | SRE capacity limited this sprint | 8h | github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/811, slack:#console-trace-thread

5) SLO runbook for streaming fallbacks | eng-sre | Priya Shah | draft | write P0/P1 decision tree | 2025-03-12 | need example incident data from hosting team | 5h | JIRA-5123

6) Growth: rollout email for opt-in beta | growth | Maya Chen | ready | coordinate send with product switch | 2025-03-11 | copy LGTM pending legal review | 2h | campaign:q2-beta-launch

7) Security: key rotation checklist for private customers | security | Daniel Kim | blocked | confirm HSM vendor timeline | 2025-04-01 | vendor-side delay; customer commitments at risk | 2h | vendor-ticket-9987

Quick counts (auto-summary):
- total items tracked: 7
- in_progress: 3
- blocked: 2
- ready: 1
- draft: 1

Top open blockers (notes):
- Legal wording for Dedicated canary burst (affects capacity billing). Action: Legal + Product sync 2025-03-05.
- Security/HSM vendor timeline delaying private deployments. Action: Daniel to escalate to vendor CSM, copy customer success.

Budget/Estimate (very rough):
- Additional infra dev cost this sprint (inc. on-call overlap): ~16 dev-hours (~$2.4k burn estimate for contracted infra ops).
- Contingency ask to finance: $10k for unexpected private test hardware (if vendor delay >3 weeks).

Notes to self / raw brainstorms: 
- Consider temporary traffic shaping vs full rate-limit enforcement for initial canary to reduce customer impact.
- If SRE can't support traces for console widget, surface synthetic traces instead (cheaper).
- Might fold the Dedicated burst language into the standard FAQ for sales to avoid repeated legal review.
- Need a one-page 'what to tell customers' for Growth (short bullets).

Unresolved questions:
- Which customers are prioritized for the private-deployment early batch? (Waiting on CS list)
- Do we GA the per-route observability flag with streaming or behind feature-flag? (Product decision)

Next steps before next async update (2025-03-11):
- Marcus: deploy smoke tokens and report latency metrics.
- Aisha: chase Legal + post a short summary to #legal-ops by 2025-03-05.
- Priya: draft SLO decision tree and attach sample incident (due 2025-03-12).
- Daniel: escalate HSM ETA and copy CS lead.

Change log (light):
- 2025-02-14 initial table created (Lena)
- 2025-02-20 added Dedicated canary row (Aisha)
- 2025-03-01 updated SRE owner and draft SLO (Priya)
- 2025-03-04 expanded blocker notes and rough budget (Lena)

Slack refs / quick links (working):
- slack:#launch-coord (main channel)
- slack:#console-trace-thread (traces discussion)
- slack:DM Lena for quick unblock

End of tracker sheet — keep concise, update inline.
